performances.speaker: Mara
performances.text: You're V? She's been watching the lift.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Been waiting long?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Been waiting long?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Not long. Got us a table.

performances.speaker: Mara
performances.text: Then use it. Kitchen's still open.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Second date. Thought we could try eating this time.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: First one came with a pretty good gift.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: First one came with a pretty good gift.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Glad you liked it. Tonight you get dinner, too. Staying?

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Yeah.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Yeah.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Dinner between friends, yeah?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Dinner between friends, yeah?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Yeah. Glad you came.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: This dinner come with a job?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: This dinner come with a job?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: No. I wanted to see you. That's all.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Need to take care of something. I'll come back.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Need to take care of something. I'll come back.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: All right. Find me here.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Try the noodles before they go cold. I got distracted ordering the drinks.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: What do you do when you're not working?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: What do you do when you're not working?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Got a little radio in pieces on my desk.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Fixing it?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Fixing it?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Trying. Replaced the tuner twice. Still only gets one station.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Any good?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Any good?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Hate it. That's why I'm fixing the radio.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Why this place?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Why this place?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Used to live somewhere with a window painted on the wall. Wanted a real one for a change.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Must've saved on the rent.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Must've saved on the rent.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: No. Had curtains, too. Charged extra for those.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Your friend. How's she doing?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Your friend. How's she doing?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Sent me a picture of a lamp she bought. Big orange thing. Looked half melted.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: She like it?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: She like it?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Enough to send me three pictures.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Sounds good.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Sounds good.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Yeah. It does. Rather leave it there, though.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Sure.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Sure.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Get much shit about the bows?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Get much shit about the bows?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Had a client tell me I'd look more professional without them.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: What'd you say?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: What'd you say?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Nothing. Finished his job, sent the invoice.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: He pay?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: He pay?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Every eddie.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Picked a good view.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Picked a good view.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Could look at the city, too.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Later.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Later.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: All right.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Been a while since I sat down for a meal like this.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Been a while since I sat down for a meal like this.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Nobody paying you to be here?

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Nobody trying to hurry me out.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Nobody trying to hurry me out.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Stay a while, then. I wasn't planning on leaving early.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Guy wanted Heartbreaker to make his ex call him.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Didn't read the description?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Didn't read the description?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Read enough to argue. Said he was offering good money.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: What'd you tell him?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: What'd you tell him?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: She could already call him.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Need to step out. Be back.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Need to step out. Be back.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: All right. I'll keep your seat.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: V. Did you send me that?

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: No. Been sitting right here.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: No. Been sitting right here.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: It used something from our messages. About the bows.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Show me the whole thing.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Show me the whole thing.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Here. Sender, time, the link. Everything I got.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Wants your signing key.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Wants your signing key.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Yeah. That part's clear.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Could be something in your implant.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Could be something in your implant.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Could be. Let's check what came through before I start pulling things apart.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Message cache. That's where they got it.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Expired contractor account. Still let them in.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Expired contractor account. Still let them in.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Terminal kept part of our thread with the reservation. They copied it, put your name on the sender. Sent it through that relay.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Discreet mercenary. They leave out the shooting?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Discreet mercenary. They leave out the shooting?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Trying to get a booking, V.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Seems pretty personal for an advert.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Seems pretty personal for an advert.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: They knew where I'd be tonight. That's the part I'm worried about.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Check SUNSET-2 against the courier receipt.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Same reference. Latch rented it. Aster paid.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Same reference. Latch rented it. Aster paid.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Aster's a club. Expensive one. I'd like to know what they think they're buying.

performances.speaker: Mara
performances.text: If you're heading downstairs, service stairs are shut.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Something happen?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Something happen?

performances.speaker: Mara
performances.text: Courier had the lift panel open. Claimed he was maintenance. Couldn't tell me who sent him.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Need to find out where that message came from. What else they copied.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Mara. Need a look at your booking system.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Mara. Need a look at your booking system.

performances.speaker: Mara
performances.text: Maintenance computer. Lounge floor, by the street lift. I'll unlock it. Leave the shift records alone.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Start with the service log. Then we'll check that link.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: I can send a dummy credential. Nothing attached. When they try to use it, we get the request. Real key stays with me.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Show me what you're sending. Then we go together.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Show me what you're sending. Then we go together.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: I'll send you a preview. Check it before I do anything.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: I'll check the relay. You stay here with Mara until I call.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: I'll check the relay. You stay here with Mara until I call.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: All right. Call me when you've got it. I'll check my end.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: No bait. Kill the stolen token. Give security the rest.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: No bait. Kill the stolen token. Give security the rest.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Don't like leaving him down there. But... all right. Send Mara the log. I'll revoke it.

performances.speaker: Latch
performances.text: You're not supposed to be here.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: You put my name on the invitation.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: You put my name on the invitation.

performances.speaker: Latch
performances.text: Look. Relay's rented. Her signing key's worth more than the fucking box.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Keep your fee. Give me the relay audit and we're done.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Keep your fee. Give me the relay audit and we're done.

performances.speaker: Latch
performances.text: Client paid already. Fine. Take it. I'm not refunding them.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Got you on camera. Give me the client and the audit. I'll leave the rest with venue security.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Got you on camera. Give me the client and the audit. I'll leave the rest with venue security.

performances.speaker: Latch
performances.text: Aster. Account said retention outreach. That's all I got.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Put the gun down.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Put the gun down.

performances.speaker: Latch
performances.text: Come take it.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: They tried the dummy. Got nothing. Real key's safe, and the stolen token's dead.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: What about the profile?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: What about the profile?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Gone. Kept a copy with the contact details stripped out. Might need it.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Should've shown you the decoy before asking you to come down with me.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Asked. You showed me.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Asked. You showed me.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Yeah. Next time I'll start there.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Token's dead. Mara's got the report. Security can deal with Latch.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Good enough for tonight.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Good enough for tonight.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Yeah. Thanks for staying long enough to find the hole.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Glad you came back up. Wasn't sure how much evening we had left.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Wanted my own look at the relay. Wasn't accusing you of setting me up.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Wanted my own look at the relay. Wasn't accusing you of setting me up.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: I know. Took me a minute.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Next time, we compare notes before we move.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Next time, we compare notes before we move.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Think we should keep this to work for now.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Think we should keep this to work for now.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: All right. If I find anything else, you'll get the details before I ask you to do a thing.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: If another message comes through like that, call me. We should have something to check it against.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Terrible weather for a rooftop.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Terrible weather for a rooftop.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Then stop inviting lightning.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: That'll do. Dinner's still on me, by the way. Including whatever Mara charges for keeping it warm.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Like to do this again. As friends.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Like to do this again. As friends.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Yeah. I'd like that. Somewhere with a working awning?

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Next time, I want it to be a date.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Next time, I want it to be a date.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Good. I was hoping you'd say that.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Let's get through one dinner first.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Let's get through one dinner first.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Fair. You want anything else? I could still eat.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: Can I?

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: Can I?

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: Yeah.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: I've covered dinner. If Aster turns into a job, I'll send the details and a rate.

performances.speaker: V Female
performances.text: All right. Get home safe.

performances.speaker: V Male
performances.text: All right. Get home safe.

performances.speaker: Velvet
performances.text: You too, V.
